newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR QUOTED LARGELY WEAKER ON TUESDAY.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR QUOTED LARGELY WEAKER ON TUESDAY.

text.p: The Zimbabwe dollar was quoted slightly weaker against most hard units on the back of early foreign currency buying on the interbank market on Tuesday, dealers said.
"It looks like people are still trying to cover for a fairly large import payment which went out yesterday," one dealer said.
The local dollar was trading at 11.3080/3180 on the U.S. dollar at around 0745 GMT, marginally easier compared to Monday's close of 11.3060/3160.
It also lost ground on sterling to 18.3615/3730 from 18.2585/2860, tracking a softer U.S. dollar overseas and was quoted at 2.5400/5425 from 2.5320/5360 versus the rand.
Against the mark however the Zimbabwe dollar firmed a little to 6.6460/6485 from 6.6730/6795.
